name: sgs/cart
title: SGS Cart
description: WooCommerce mini-cart: live item-count badge plus an optional flyout (disclosure) or drawer (dialog) panel with AJAX add/qty/remove via the WooCommerce Store API. Hydrates client-side to bypass full-page cache.

badgeBackground.reason: The cart-icon badge is a status indicator nested inside .sgs-cart__trigger, not itself a click target — no :hover CSS targets it anywhere in style.css.

panelBackground.reason: The flyout/drawer panel surface is not a click target — its child close/view/checkout buttons carry their own separate colour attributes. No :hover CSS targets the panel background anywhere.

item-actions.label: Basket line actions row
item-actions._note: The basket line actions row: a flex row; the wrap setting chooses between one line and wrapping onto further rows.

panel-actions.label: Basket panel buttons row
panel-actions._note: The basket panel buttons row: a flex row; the wrap setting chooses between one line and wrapping onto further rows.

scrim.label: Backdrop / scrim
scrim._note: The shared viewport scrim (Wave 3C U-2, `includes/helpers-scrim.php::sgs_scrim_render`): the see-through layer printed at wp_footer that dims the page while this block's drawer, dialog or panel is open. Mapped here so the converter can route a draft's scrim colour, strength and blur to these attributes.

wrapper.label: Cart wrapper
wrapper._note: supports.color is explicitly {background:false,text:false} and spacing.padding is false — layout is scoped to margin only (every other layout member is a real gap, not a missing declaration).

icon.label: Cart icon
icon._note: The cart icon's own colour, and the icon button's background (iconBg and its gradient and hover siblings, painted on the trigger's ::after layer in icon devices only, because the pill keeps its own background in pillBgColour). iconSize (the glyph size) is mapped on the iconGlyph element. `css:stroke` (icon/SVG gradient mechanism) is explicit-mapped to iconColourGradient: non-empty wins over iconColour's flat currentColor paint at render time (helpers-svg-gradient.php). iconColourHover/iconColourHoverGradient mirror sgs/icon's own hover states shape exactly, resolved via sgs_icon_gradient_css() on .sgs-cart__trigger:hover.
icon.absentWhy: The pill trigger shows its label and count in place of the icon.

trigger.label: Trigger button
trigger._note: The icon button and the text pill are one element (.sgs-cart__trigger) and each device shows one of them, so the radius, size and padding are one setting each. triggerSize prints min-width and min-height in an icon device and min-height only in a pill device. The backgrounds stay separate (iconBg* on the icon element, pillBgColour* on the pill element) because a colour is not per device: a block that shows the pill on desktop and the icon button on tablet keeps a different fill for each.

iconGlyph.label: Cart icon glyph
iconGlyph._note: The cart glyph: iconSize prints --sgs-cart-icon-size on the block, which sizes the icon box and the svg inside it.
iconGlyph.absentWhy: The pill trigger shows its label and count in place of the icon.

badge.label: Item-count badge
badge._note: badgeColour/badgeTextColour do not follow the default {prefix}{suffix} convention — explicit attrMap required per ROLLOUT REQUIREMENT 1. Gradient siblings: badgeColourGradient paints a hand-built ::after layer (NOT sgs_block_background_layer_css() — the badge is already position:absolute, which that helper would silently override), freeing the element's own background-image for badgeTextColourGradient's background-clip:text. badgeTextColourHover/badgeTextColourHoverGradient are safe to paint directly on .sgs-cart__badge because the badge's own background always lives on its ::after layer, never on the badge element itself — background-clip:text on hover cannot clip a background that isn't there.

panel.label: Mini-cart panel
panel._note: FR-36-19 — the flyout/drawer panel surface. panelBg/panelTextColour do not follow {prefix}{suffix} — explicit attrMap. Only rendered when displayMode is flyout|drawer. Gradient siblings use the same hand-built ::after reasoning as the badge element above (the panel's own --flyout/--drawer modifiers declare position:absolute/fixed, at the same specificity a uid-scoped sgs_block_background_layer_css() rule would carry). panelTextColourHover/panelTextColourHoverGradient are safe for the same reason as the badge above — the panel's own background always lives on its ::after layer.
panel.absentWhy: Link mode opens the cart page and builds no flyout or drawer panel.

pill.label: Trigger pill (text style)
pill._note: triggerStyle:'pill' swaps the icon+badge trigger for a word (pillLabel) beside the live item count, in a pill (matches a 'Bag'/'Cart' text trigger draft shape). The pill's own background, text, border and shadow are mapped here; the trigger's radius, size and padding are shared with the icon button (the trigger element above), and the icon button keeps its own background in iconBg*. pillTextColour styles the LABEL only; the count beside it keeps using badgeTextColour/badgeTextColourGradient (same badge element, restyled for the pill by style.css, so one colour control governs the count in both trigger styles). Border: pillBorderWidth (box object, base only) + pillBorderStyle (enum) + pillBorderColour (flat, no gradient sibling) mount through `SgsBorderControl` (Spec 35 section 14, field 9f). The layout cluster is claimed only so css:border-color, css:border-width and css:border-style resolve against this element's own attrMap instead of reporting ORPHAN:STYLE-DEFECT.

freeDeliveryTrack.label: Free-delivery progress track
freeDeliveryTrack._note: Wave B — the empty background of the free-delivery progress bar in the mini-cart panel (flyout or drawer). Only rendered when a threshold (manual override or the WooCommerce free-shipping zone method's min_amount) resolves to a positive number; both empty hides the whole feature. Built entirely client-side (panel-render.js) against Store API cart totals — see render.php's data-free-delivery-* attributes on the block wrapper, which is the only part of this feature render.php can own (the panel BODY markup lives in the shared includes/helpers-cart-panel.php, outside this build's file scope). freeDeliveryMessage/freeDeliverySuccessMessage (the progress-bar's two text states, edited in PanelSettingsControls.js) are declared here as `contentAttrs` — the content half of this element, not a style attribute, following Spec 35's PLACEMENT model (THE ELEMENT MANIFEST §ContentAttrs).

freeDeliveryFill.label: Free-delivery progress fill
freeDeliveryFill._note: Wave B — the filled portion of the free-delivery progress bar, width driven live by a --sgs-cart-free-delivery-pct custom property (panel-render.js element.style.setProperty()) — a custom-property VALUE, never a raw style="width:..." declaration (Spec 32 FR-32-4; mirrors sgs/audio's --sgs-progress and sgs/before-after's --sgs-before-after-position).

panelFrame.label: Panel frame
panelFrame._note: Drawer surface geometry. The dialog carries the block uid class itself because the shared nav store re-parents it to <body> on open, so every panel rule is scoped to `.{uid}.sgs-cart__panel`, never the block wrapper. panelShadowColour pairs with panelShadow through ShadowControl; panelSlideDuration/panelSlideEasing are the drawer slide's duration and curve, emitted as animation-duration/animation-timing-function on the open panel: the slide in plays them forwards and the close plays the same animation reversed (style.css `.sgs-cart__panel--drawer.is-closing`); panelSlideEasingCustom holds a hand-typed curve.
panelFrame.absentWhy: Link mode opens the cart page and builds no flyout or drawer panel.

panelHead.label: Panel head row
panelHead.absentWhy: Link mode opens the cart page and builds no flyout or drawer panel.

panelTitle.label: Panel heading
panelTitle.absentWhy: Link mode opens the cart page and builds no flyout or drawer panel.

panelCount.label: Panel heading count
panelCount._note: The bracketed live item count after the heading; shown when panelShowCount is on.
panelCount.absentWhy: Link mode opens the cart page and builds no flyout or drawer panel.

panelClose.label: Panel close button
panelClose.absentWhy: Link mode opens the cart page and builds no flyout or drawer panel. The close button is drawer-only; a flyout panel closes on outside click and Escape.

panelBody.label: Panel body
panelBody.absentWhy: Link mode opens the cart page and builds no flyout or drawer panel.

itemQty.label: Item quantity stepper
itemQty._note: The item row's quantity stepper (itemQtyStyle 'stepper'): a minus button, the number and a plus button in one pill. Only drawn when the stepper style is chosen.

panelView.label: View cart button or link
panelView._note: The footer's second action: an outlined button, or with panelViewStyle 'text-link' an underlined text link. Its corners follow the Checkout corners setting.
panelView.absentWhy: Link mode opens the cart page and builds no flyout or drawer panel.

panelTaxNote.label: Note under the subtotal
panelTaxNote._note: The delivery note under the subtotal row (panelTaxNote is its wording). The Note under Checkout element (panelNote) is the instalments note, a different paragraph.
panelTaxNote.absentWhy: Link mode opens the cart page and builds no flyout or drawer panel.

freeDeliveryBand.label: Free-delivery band
freeDeliveryBand._note: The band holding the free-delivery message and its bar. Set only the bottom border width for a line under it.

panelFooter.label: Panel footer
panelFooter.absentWhy: Link mode opens the cart page and builds no flyout or drawer panel.

subtotal.label: Subtotal row
subtotal._note: subtotalLabelColour colours the label and row; the amount on the right is its own element (subtotalValue).
subtotal.absentWhy: Link mode opens the cart page and builds no flyout or drawer panel.

subtotalValue.label: Subtotal amount
subtotalValue.absentWhy: Link mode opens the cart page and builds no flyout or drawer panel.

checkout.label: Checkout button
checkout.absentWhy: Link mode opens the cart page and builds no flyout or drawer panel.

panelNote.label: Note under checkout
panelNote.absentWhy: Link mode opens the cart page and builds no flyout or drawer panel.

panelCloseIcon.label: Panel close icon
panelCloseIcon._note: The x glyph inside the drawer close button: panelCloseSize sizes it, panelCloseTapSize sizes the button around it.
panelCloseIcon.absentWhy: Link mode builds no panel, and the close button is drawer-only.

itemQtyNumber.label: Item quantity number
itemQtyNumber._note: The number between the stepper buttons (itemQtyStyle stepper).
itemQtyNumber.absentWhy: Link mode opens the cart page and builds no flyout or drawer panel.

emptyBody.label: Empty-basket text line
emptyBody.absentWhy: Link mode opens the cart page and builds no flyout or drawer panel.

emptyLink.label: Empty-basket text link
emptyLink.absentWhy: Link mode opens the cart page and builds no flyout or drawer panel.

giftBox.label: Gift box
giftBox.absentWhy: Link mode opens the cart page and builds no flyout or drawer panel.

giftLabel.label: Gift box label
giftLabel.absentWhy: Link mode opens the cart page and builds no flyout or drawer panel.

giftHelp.label: Gift box helper line
giftHelp.absentWhy: Link mode opens the cart page and builds no flyout or drawer panel.

giftMessage.label: Gift note field
giftMessage._note: The gift note field; the recipient field takes the same field look (giftField*).
giftMessage.absentWhy: Link mode opens the cart page and builds no flyout or drawer panel.

upsell.label: Upsell row
upsell.absentWhy: Link mode opens the cart page and builds no flyout or drawer panel.

upsellTitle.label: Upsell heading
upsellTitle.absentWhy: Link mode opens the cart page and builds no flyout or drawer panel.

upsellText.label: Upsell text line
upsellText.absentWhy: Link mode opens the cart page and builds no flyout or drawer panel.

upsellImage.label: Upsell picture
upsellImage.absentWhy: Link mode opens the cart page and builds no flyout or drawer panel.

itemActionsFlexWrap.description: Whether the actions under each basket line wrap onto further rows when they overrun the row. Empty keeps the stylesheet's own behaviour.

panelActionsFlexWrap.description: Whether the View basket and Checkout buttons wrap onto further rows when they overrun the row. Empty keeps the stylesheet's own behaviour.

iconSource.description: Where the cart glyph comes from: the Lucide icon named by iconName, or a pasted SVG (iconSvg).

iconSvg.description: Pasted inline SVG markup when iconSource is 'custom'. Sanitised in the editor and re-sanitised in render.php (wp_kses + sgs_svg_kses_allowed_tags()); an empty or rejected SVG falls back to the Lucide icon.

iconSize.description: Icon size in px per breakpoint: {desktop,tablet,mobile}. An empty tier inherits the tier above; unset keeps 24px.

triggerSize.description: Trigger size per device {desktop:{width,height},…}: CSS lengths or theme spacing presets, printed as min-width and min-height on the trigger. A text pill takes the height only (its width follows its label). A set value replaces the 44px tap floor at that device and prints as saved; unset keeps the floor.

triggerPadding.description: Trigger padding box per breakpoint: {desktop,tablet,mobile} of {top,right,bottom,left}, for the icon button and the text pill alike. Empty keeps style.css's own padding (0 for the icon button, 0 14px for the pill).

triggerBorderRadius.description: CSS length (e.g. "999px" or "50%") for the trigger's corners, icon button and text pill alike. Empty keeps style.css's own radius (4px for the icon button, fully rounded for the pill).

iconBgGradient.description: CSS gradient painting the icon button's background. Non-empty wins over iconBg.

badgeSize.description: Icon trigger count badge size in px per breakpoint. Unset keeps 18px.

pillBadgeSize.description: Text pill count bubble size in px per breakpoint. Unset keeps 20px.

iconColour.description: Icon and pill label colour. Empty takes the surrounding text colour, which the theme pairs with its surface.

iconColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the cart icon's stroke instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over iconColour at render time.

iconColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the cart icon's stroke on hover instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over iconColourHover at render time.

badgeTextColourHoverGradient.description: Hover-state gradient sibling of badgeTextColourHover. Non-empty wins over badgeTextColourHover on :hover/:focus-visible.

showZero.description: Show the badge on an empty cart, per breakpoint: {desktop,tablet,mobile} of booleans. An empty tier inherits the tier above; unset hides the badge until there is an item.

panelGiftShow.description: Drawer and flyout: show a "This is a gift" tick box above the footer while the basket holds an item. It reads and writes the same gift value the Gift order block keeps for the basket page, the checkout and the order. Off by default.

panelGiftHelp.description: A helper line under the gift tick box's label. Empty prints none.

panelGiftToLabel.description: Label of the recipient-name field that appears when the gift box is ticked.

panelGiftMessageLabel.description: Label of the note field that appears when the gift box is ticked.

emptyBody.description: A line of text under the empty-basket heading. Empty prints none. Any of the empty-basket picture, body line, product button or link address turns on the centred empty state.

emptyProductId.description: The product the empty-basket button adds in one tap (0 prints no button). A simple product, or a variable product whose default options name a buyable variation, is added to the basket; any other product makes the button a link to its page.

emptyButtonLabel.description: The empty-basket button's label; {price} is replaced with the chosen product's current price.

emptyCtaUrl.description: Where the empty-basket text link goes. Empty uses the shop page. The link's wording is the Empty-cart button text; leaving that blank hides the link when the centred empty state is on.

panelTextColourHoverGradient.description: Hover-state gradient sibling of panelTextColourHover. Non-empty wins over panelTextColourHover on :hover/:focus-visible.

scrimColour.description: Wave 3C U-2 (family M-14): the drawer's backdrop tint. Only painted in the drawer display mode; see includes/helpers-scrim.php.

triggerStyle.description: Wave B — 'icon' is the existing icon+badge trigger. 'pill' replaces the icon with an editable word (pillLabel) beside the live item count, in a pill shape.

triggerStyleTablet.description: Tablet-tier override of triggerStyle (viewport up to 1023px). Empty inherits the desktop triggerStyle. One button and one drawer print at every width; the tier switches the label, icon and count visibility by class and stylesheet.

triggerStyleMobile.description: Mobile-tier override of triggerStyle (viewport up to 767px). Empty inherits the resolved tablet value.

pillShowIcon.description: In a pill tier, show the cart icon (sized by iconSize) before the label. Off keeps the word-and-count pill.

pillCountStyle.description: How the pill shows its item count: plain text beside the label, or a round filled bubble (badgeColour fill, badgeTextColour text).

pillBgColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the trigger pill's background via background-image. Non-empty wins over pillBgColour at render time.

pillTextColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the pill label text via background-clip:text. Non-empty wins over pillTextColour at render time.

pillBorderWidth.description: Pill border width, base tier only (Spec 35 §14 — no per-device border width). Empty = the block's own CSS default (1px).

pillBorderStyle.description: Pill border style. '' = inherit the block's own CSS default (solid).

freeDeliveryThresholdOverride.description: Wave B — manual override for the free-delivery threshold, in the store's currency major unit (e.g. "75"). Empty uses the WooCommerce free-shipping method's min_amount for the store's base-country shipping zone. Both empty hides the progress bar.

separators.description: The line between the mini-cart panel's item rows (the shared Separators setting, includes/helpers-separators.php): { row: { style, width: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, colour } }. A horizontal line centred in the space between items (`panelBodyGap`), drawn by the rows themselves. No thickness (the default) draws nothing; no colour inherits the text colour.

panelMaxWidth.description: Drawer maximum width per device (CSS length). Empty keeps the 400px default.

panelBodyGap.description: Gap between item rows in the panel body, per device (CSS length). Empty keeps 18px.

panelCloseSize.description: Close (x) icon size per device (CSS length). Empty keeps 24px.

itemThumbSize.description: Item image column width per device (CSS length); the image stays square. Empty keeps 96px.

itemGap.description: Gap between an item image and its text per device (CSS length). Empty keeps 16px.

emptyMessageGap.description: Space under the empty-cart message, per device (CSS length). Empty keeps 8px.

freeDeliveryTrackHeight.description: Free-delivery progress track height per device (CSS length). Empty keeps 6px.

checkoutMinHeight.description: Checkout button height floor per device (CSS length). Empty keeps 44px.

panelHeadPadding.description: Panel head row padding: tier object of boxes {desktop,tablet,mobile}.

panelBodyPadding.description: Panel body (item list) padding: tier object of boxes.

panelFooterPadding.description: Panel footer padding: tier object of boxes.

panelEmptyPadding.description: Empty-cart block padding: tier object of boxes.

emptyCtaPadding.description: Empty-cart button padding: tier object of boxes.

freeDeliveryBarMargin.description: Margin around the free-delivery progress track: tier object of boxes.

itemThumbRadius.description: Item image corner radius (CSS length). Empty keeps 4px.

emptyCtaRadius.description: Empty-cart button corner radius (CSS length). Empty keeps 4px.

checkoutRadius.description: Checkout and View cart button corner radius (CSS length). Empty keeps 4px.

freeDeliveryTrackRadius.description: Free-delivery track corner radius (CSS length). Empty keeps fully rounded.

panelSlideDuration.description: Drawer slide duration in milliseconds: the slide in, and reversed, the slide out. 0 keeps the 250ms default.

panelSlideEasing.description: Drawer slide easing (the slide out plays it reversed), a named easing from the shared motion easing list (includes/helpers-motion-easing.php). Empty keeps ease-out.

scrimFadeDuration.description: Fade time of the dimmed layer behind the open drawer, in milliseconds. 0 (default) fades in step with the drawer slide, or the shared scrim's 200ms when the slide time is unset.

panelSlideEasingCustom.description: Custom cubic-bezier curve, read when panelSlideEasing is custom.

panelShowCount.description: Show the live item count in brackets after the panel heading, e.g. "Bag (2)".

panelShowViewCart.description: Show the View cart button in the panel footer.

itemQtyStyle.description: 'input' is the native number box; 'stepper' is a minus button, the number and a plus button in one pill.

itemQtyHeight.description: Stepper height per device (CSS length). Empty keeps 44px.

itemQtyBorderWidth.description: Stepper pill border width (box object). Empty keeps no border.

itemQtyRadius.description: Stepper pill corner radius (CSS length). Empty keeps fully rounded.

panelViewStyle.description: 'outline' is the outlined View cart button; 'text-link' is an underlined text link.

panelActionsLayout.description: 'row' puts Checkout and View cart side by side; 'stacked' puts Checkout full width with View cart centred under it.

panelViewColourHover.description: View cart text colour on hover and keyboard focus.

itemRemovePlacement.description: Where the text-style Remove link sits: 'under' the quantity, or 'inline-end' at the right of the quantity's own line. Only reads when the remove style is a text link and the quantity is shown.

panelTaxNoteColour.description: Colour of the note under the subtotal (the delivery note).

freeDeliveryBandBg.description: Background colour of the free-delivery band (its message and bar).

freeDeliveryBandBorderWidth.description: Border width of the free-delivery band (box object): set only the bottom for a line under it.

freeDeliveryBandPadding.description: Padding of the free-delivery band: tier object of boxes.

autoOpenDrawerOnAdd.description: Drawer mode only: open the drawer when an item is added elsewhere on the page. Off by default because a drawer is a modal takeover; the Add to basket confirmation toast still offers View bag. Needs 'Auto-open when an item is added' on as well.

itemShowQty.description: Show the quantity input on each item row.

itemShowSaveForLater.description: Show the Save for later action on each item row.

itemShowAddOptions.description: Show a link on each item row inviting the shopper to finish configuring that item. It hides itself on any row that already carries priced add-on choices, and links to that item's own product page, where the options pop-up opens. Off by default: it is only useful on a shop whose products have optional priced extras.

itemAddOptionsLabel.description: The label for the per-item "finish configuring this" link, e.g. "Add my prescription" or "Choose a finish". Empty (default) hides the link, so no wording is assumed for any trade.

itemRemoveStyle.description: 'icon' is the x button in its own column; 'text' is an underlined text link under the item details.

itemRemoveLabel.description: Label of the text-style remove link.

freeDeliveryHideWhenEmpty.description: Hide the free-delivery message and bar while the bag is empty (placement above-items; the footer placement is already hidden when empty).

freeDeliveryFillDuration.description: Seconds the free-delivery bar takes to fill to its new level (0 to 3).

freeDeliveryFillEasing.description: How the free-delivery bar's fill speeds up and slows down: 'smooth' is a quick start and a gentle finish.

freeDeliveryPlacement.description: 'above-items' shows the message and bar above the item list; 'footer' places them in the panel footer under the subtotal.

panelTaxNote.default: Shipping and taxes calculated at checkout.
panelTaxNote.description: Small note under the subtotal. Empty hides it.

panelInstalmentsNote.description: Optional note under the checkout button; %s is replaced by the subtotal divided by panelInstalmentsCount. Empty hides it.

panelInstalmentsCount.description: Number of instalments used to compute the amount in panelInstalmentsNote.

itemRemoveTextDecoration.description: Text decoration of the text-style Remove link. Set, it replaces the line drawn under the link (its bottom border).

itemRemovePadding.description: Padding of the text-style Remove link: tier object of boxes. Empty keeps the stylesheet default.

itemQtyNumberWidth.description: Width of the number between the stepper buttons, per device (CSS length). Empty keeps the stylesheet default (3 characters, at least 22px).

panelEmptyPlacement.description: Where the empty basket sits in the panel: '' at the top (default), 'center' centred in the space the item list takes.

emptyBodyColour.description: Colour of the line of text under the empty-basket heading.

emptyBodyMaxWidth.description: Widest the line of text under the empty-basket heading may run, per device (CSS length). Empty keeps the stylesheet default.

emptyLinkColour.description: Colour of the empty-basket text link.

emptyLinkPadding.description: Padding of the empty-basket text link: tier object of boxes. Empty keeps the stylesheet default.

panelCloseTapSize.description: Close button tap area (its width and height floor), per device (CSS length). Empty keeps the stylesheet default (44px, or the icon alone when panelCloseSize is set).

panelGiftPlacement.description: Where the gift box sits: 'footer' (default) between the item list and the footer, or 'after-items' inside the scrolling list, under the last line.

giftBoxBorderWidth.description: Gift box border width (box object). Empty keeps no border.

giftBoxRadius.description: Gift box corner radius (CSS length). Empty keeps square corners.

giftBoxPadding.description: Gift box padding: tier object of boxes. Empty keeps the stylesheet default.

giftBoxMargin.description: Gift box margin: tier object of boxes. Empty keeps the stylesheet default.

giftHelpColour.description: Colour of the helper line under the gift label (set, it is drawn at full strength).

giftFieldBg.description: Background colour of the gift name and note fields.

giftFieldBorderWidth.description: Border width of the gift name and note fields (box object). Empty keeps the browser border.

giftFieldBorderStyle.description: Border style of the gift name and note fields.

giftFieldBorderColour.description: Border colour of the gift name and note fields.

giftFieldRadius.description: Corner radius of the gift name and note fields (CSS length).

giftFieldPadding.description: Padding of the gift name and note fields: tier object of boxes. Empty keeps the stylesheet default.

upsellProductId.description: A product offered in a row under the basket lines, with an Add button (0 prints no row). The row hides while that product is in the basket. A simple product, or a variable product whose default options are all set, is added in one tap; any other product makes the button a link to its page.

upsellTitle.description: The upsell row's heading. Empty uses the product's name.

upsellText.description: A line of text under the upsell heading; {price} is replaced with the product's current price. Empty prints none.

upsellButtonLabel.description: The label on the upsell row's button; {price} is replaced with the product's current price.

upsellShowImage.description: Show the product's picture at the start of the upsell row.

upsellPadding.description: Upsell row padding: tier object of boxes. Empty keeps the stylesheet default.

upsellTextColour.description: Colour of the line under the upsell heading.

upsellImageSize.description: Upsell picture size (square), per device (CSS length). Empty keeps the stylesheet default (56px).

upsellButtonBgHover.description: Upsell button background colour on hover and keyboard focus.

upsellButtonColourHover.description: Upsell button text colour on hover and keyboard focus.

upsellButtonBorderWidth.description: Upsell button border width (box object). Empty keeps the stylesheet border.

upsellButtonPadding.description: Upsell button padding: tier object of boxes. Empty keeps the stylesheet default.
